settings.title: Done in-house
settings.text: Every device is inspected, repaired and graded by our own technicians in the GTA. No middlemen.

settings.title: Battery health you can trust
settings.text: Minimum 80% battery health on every phone. The exact number is listed before you buy.

settings.title: Clean slate
settings.text: Factory reset, full data wipe, and a deep clean and polish on every device we sell.

settings.title: Real people, real stores
settings.text: Talk to a real person by phone, chat, or at one of our stores when you need help.

settings.title: Better for the planet
settings.text: Buying refurbished keeps working tech in use and out of landfill.

settings.title: No red flags
settings.text: Every device is checked to be unlocked, not blacklisted, and not reported lost or stolen.

settings.title: Peace of mind
settings.text: Every purchase comes with a 1-year warranty, free 30-day returns, and support when you need it.
